title: Mystery Ranch NICE Frame Load Sling

infobox.trader: Peacekeeper LL3, after unlocking it in BattlePass Season 1

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The backpack is modeled after the Mystery Ranch NICE Frame fitted with the company's Load Sling system, carrying a Pelican 1510 Protector Carry-On Case in OD Green.
- The webbing attached to the load sling is outfitted with several commercially available accessories, including:
  - Three THYRM CellVault Battery Storage containers in orange.
  - Three CobraCuffs Foldable Cobra Cuffs in black.
  - One CobraCuffs Foldable Cobra Cuff in tan.
